summary.text: Richard Sills, a Natural Law Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 2nd District to John Moolenaar.
According to Ballotpedia, he has worked in meat processing, printing and marketing and farming.

paragraphs.text: Richard Sills is a native of the Cincinnati area who moved to Michigan in 1983, according to Ballotpedia.
He worked in the meat-packing industry and owned two meat processing plants in Michigan; Ballotpedia says he was involved in implementing a federal safety-standards program for the industry.
Sills also worked in the printing and marketing industries and, when he entered the 2018 election, was an ostrich farmer.
He received 0.5% of the vote to John Moolenaar's 61.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
